about: Synthetic response shapes extracted from the read-only old Naver tests. source line numbers refer to oldskills/naver-blog/tests/naver_blog/. Helpers were materialized with args/kwargs; no old test or platform code was changed. also_used_at records duplicate inline consumers. P4 must replace the inline builders with fixture reads while preserving each consumer assertion. Existing HTML and record fixtures remain their source of truth. Repeated generated pages with the same wire shape share a case; also_used_at lists each original source. Sharing a shape does not equate values, page sizes or expected output: P4 must retain each old test assertion and instantiate its original generation parameters.

p4.behavior: cases의 response/response_text를 실제 CLI 가짜 Aside 입력으로 연결한다. source/also_used_at의 옛 테스트 assertions를 모두 유지하며 budget/window/exit10 assertion만 S2에 따라 바꾼다.

also_used_at.use: Same response shape; preserve this old test’s original generated values, page sizes and assertions when applying the template.
